senses.gloss: m. (prob. a denom. of כַּר) a wagon, wagon-load; [b. h. gift, tribute; cmp.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 5:10">Targ. Is. V, 10</cite> (h. text <he>צמד</he>). Targ. II Esth. I, 3 <he>א׳ ומרגליין</he> (read <he>דמ׳</he>) loads (gifts) of &c. (after <cite ref="Psalms 72:10">Ps. LXXII, 10</cite>).
